previous_turn: Progress: completed prior result documentation and confirmed poor medical chunks were actually exposed to final models.
adaptation: Borrow pre-generation passage evaluation and refinement. Use original untuned models on existing whole chunks; not CRAG fine-tuned T5, strip decomposition, thresholds, web search or full reproduction.

criteria.topical: Is this passage topically relevant to the named diagnosis?
criteria.clinical: Does this passage explicitly state at least one specific clinical finding, risk factor, time course, examination finding, or diagnostic test result that can help support or distinguish the named diagnosis? A learning objective, a promise to discuss these facts, a generic diagnostic introduction, or treatment advice alone is insufficient. Judge the information actually stated in the passage; do not supply missing facts from memory.

shared_inputs: Same original40 R3 development targets, calibrated4 shortlist, cached40 diagnosis-only queries and top8 documents/query. Same old80 union reranks. No new retrieval or query/spelling repair in this controlled experiment.
policy: Each original model independently scores topical relevance and explicit clinical facts for all8 chunks/candidate. Two reversed True/False mappings, mean aligned raw log-odds. Rank within candidate, stable original-rank ties; allocate2 unique chunks/candidate and present8 in existing common MedCPT order. No score threshold or posthoc disease gate.
final: Retain exact original model, system, patient question and answer contract; replace only8 documents. Same4 shortlist,8 list orders, plurality and initial-pool ties.
controls: Clinical versus topical at equal model calls is primary. Previous MedCPT-balanced/global, original-doc list8 and calibrated49 reused. Require credible cross-backbone benefit versus existing stronger controls before expansion.
costs: Each uncached deployed arm:6 frontend+64 document checks+8 final=78 original-model scores;4 retrieval queries+1 rerank. Disease-document checks may be cached per model/criterion. This pilot reuses retrieval/rerank and frontends, shares40 candidate caches within model.
scope: Exposed development only; original weights; no training patient labels, target gold, paired reference or method-specific selection enters inference.
